basic_identification.full_title: Inverse Dovetail Cutters and Dovetail Cutters with Cylindrical Shanks (Third Revision) (बेलनाकार शैंक युक्त डोवटेल कटर्स और प्रतिलोम (इन्वर्स) डोवटेल कटर्स (तीसरा पुनरीक्षण))
basic_identification.sector_category: Production and General Engineering / Cutting Tools (approved by the Production and General Engineering Division Council and finalized by the Cutting Tools Sectional Committee, PGD 32, of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

scope.summary: This Indian Standard specifies the dimensions, tolerances, shank configurations, and general requirements of inverse dovetail cutters and dovetail cutters with plain cylindrical shanks, flatted cylindrical shanks, and threaded shanks. It applies strictly to 45° and 60° dovetail cutters and inverse dovetail cutters with major cutting diameters from 16 mm to 31.5 mm.

requirements.detail: Observed or calculated final test values, thicknesses, angles, and tolerances must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The decimal places retained should match that of the specified value in the standard.
Applies strictly to 45° and 60° dovetail cutters and inverse dovetail cutters.
Specifies major cutter head diameter (d2) held to js16 limits to ensure dimensional accuracy in dovetail groove profiles.
The nominal angles of 45° and 60° are held to a tight tolerance of ±30'.
Shank diameters d1 are held to: h8 for plain cylindrical shanks, h6 for flatted cylindrical shanks, and h8 for threaded shanks.
Standardizes dimensions for 45° cutters: d2=16 (l1=4, l2=60, d1=12); d2=20 (l1=5, l2=63, d1=12); d2=25 (l1=6.3, l2=67, d1=12); d2=31.5 (l1=8, l2=71, d1=16) in millimetres.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 6255 : 2013 (Third Revision) is the primary national Indian Standard specification prescribing quality requirements, physical dimensions, and tolerances for inverse dovetail cutters and dovetail cutters with cylindrical shanks (plain, flatted, or threaded). Maintained under the Cutting Tools Sectional Committee (PGD 32), the standard unifies tool designs used for machining precise female and male dovetail slide-ways, jigs, and fixtures across industrial toolrooms. It specifies precise geometries for 45° and 60° cutters with cutting head diameters from 16 mm to 31.5 mm, enforcing strict tolerances (such as js16 for head diameter, ±30' for cutter angle, and h8/h6 for shanks) aligned with ISO 3859:2000. This ensures highly rigid, vibration-free tool holding and clean, accurate slide machining to support general engineering and structural inspections.
